literal_meaning: মুখ চালানো (মুখের গতি বা চলমান অবস্থা)
similar_in_english: running one's mouth (but for talking, not eating)
example_sentences_in_bangla: পার্টিতে সবাই গল্প করছে, সঙ্গে মুখও চলছে।
দোকানে বসে চা খেয়ে মুখ চালাচ্ছিলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: At the party, everyone is chatting, and mouths are running too (eating).
I was sitting in the shop, drinking tea and keeping my mouth busy (eating).
note: This idiom playfully refers to eating as the mouth 'running' alongside conversation.
